WORKING: Full pipeline end-to-end in Docker and Chrome-verified:
- Upload outfit photo → Gemini identifies 7 items with bounding boxes
- Sharp crops each item → Playwright service (port 3002) uploads to Vinted → gets UUIDs
- All 7 UUIDs batch-persisted to Postgres (survive container restart)
- Hunt any item → 5 Top Matches (visual, size-filtered) + 20 text results = 25 total
- Size preferences (L/30/44/M) persist in DB and apply to both visual and text search
- Dashboard, re-search from history, rescan all working
- Dev login controlled by NEXT_PUBLIC_ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN + ENABLE_DEV_LOGIN build args
